verdict.rationale: n8n's marketing material repeatedly emphasizes visual workflow building and a 'flow-logic' documentation section (covering error handling) implying support for branching workflow logic, and community reviews describe it as a mature visual builder with debuggable execution history, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents IF/Switch/Filter/Merge nodes or parallel-path merging as described in the story. Missing for 10: explicit docs/screenshots of conditional (IF/Switch) nodes, filter nodes, parallel branch execution, and a Merge node reuniting branches.
